name: ui-audit-skill
description: Multi-agent UI and functional audit skill for coding agents; loopback-only browser probe and validators.

scripts.test: node --test validate-findings.test.cjs validate-coverage-ledger.test.cjs validate-orchestration.test.cjs skill-docs.test.mjs scripts/ui-probe.test.mjs scripts/ui-diff.test.mjs scripts/orchestrate.test.mjs scripts/detect-project.test.mjs scripts/static-serve.test.mjs scripts/promote.test.mjs scripts/check-traces.test.mjs scripts/group-candidates.test.mjs scripts/setup.test.mjs
scripts.validate:example: node validate-findings.cjs examples/run-1/findings.json && node validate-coverage-ledger.cjs examples/run-1/coverage-ledger.json --metadata examples/run-1/run-metadata.json && node validate-orchestration.cjs examples/run-1/agent-log.json --kind agent-log --metadata examples/run-1/run-metadata.json --findings examples/run-1/findings.json --ledger examples/run-1/coverage-ledger.json && node validate-orchestration.cjs examples/run-1/fix/fix-log.json --kind fix-log --findings examples/run-1/findings.json --agent-log examples/run-1/fix/agent-log.json && node validate-orchestration.cjs examples/ui-audit.config.json --kind config
